name: 登録日とグループ参加日の記録
prompt: Create attempt a002, the second and final fidelity pass for this Japanese date card. The first reference image is the exact 390x108 native preview and controls the output dimensions, card size, text, colors, icon placement and line wrapping. The second reference is the current candidate and should be preserved except for the measured geometry corrections. Match the white 390x108 canvas with one pale-mint rounded rectangle at x=16,y=8,width≈358,height≈86. In the candidate, the card is about 6px too tall when normalized to the 390px canvas, and the title sits about 2px too low. Shorten the card vertically to the native height and raise the title slightly while preserving the baseline of the two date rows. Shift the left group icon about 3px right to match the native; retain both date labels and their horizontal positions. Exact copy: title 「メンバーになった日」; left 「登録・2022年7月14日」; right 「参加・2022年12月13日」 with the final 「日」 on its own second line exactly as in the native preview. Keep compact small dark-gray type, muted title and green outline icons. Do not add white framing margin around the card. The card contains no hyperlink and no text should be blue. Do not add source English labels, action buttons, photographs, extra content, shadows or borders.
reviewNotes: Version 2 shortens the card and shifts the left icon close to the native position, but now the card is about 4–5px shorter and 2–4px high; title and date row sit roughly 4–7px high. The final 日 wrap and exact Japanese content remain. Two-attempt limit reached. No hyperlink; no blue text.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
